assumptions: A rigid visual sweep satisfies the requested apparent lateral bolt motion without a separate moving part.
Single-color FDM plastic of ordinary desktop density preserves the geometry-derived center of mass.

components.form: A healed common-depth profile built from broad elliptical and finite-land polygonal lobes with a deliberately open central underside.
components.interfaces: Broadly fused into both keel shoulders and the upper rain ribbon.
components.name: Lobed storm-cloud relief
components.placement: Upper body from approximately Z16 to Z72, asymmetric around X=0.
components.purpose: Provides the holdable mass and folded storm silhouette.

components.form: R72 outer circular band, R64 offset inner cut, cropped to an 82 mm span with 8 mm nominal radial thickness.
components.interfaces: Fused at both ends into the cloud shoulders; surrounds the bolt with open negative space.
components.name: Crescent rocking keel
components.placement: Centered below the cloud from Z0 to Z24.
components.purpose: Creates the open cradle and gravity-return rocking path.

components.form: Angular lightning prism at common body depth, with a truncated tip and 1.2 mm profile-edge rounds that remove knife edges.
components.interfaces: Fused to the curved rain ribbon at its crown; otherwise surrounded by open air.
components.name: Lightning jewel
components.placement: Centered in the keel arch, descending from Z35 to Z14.
components.purpose: Supplies the crisp visual tracer whose world-space position sweeps during rocking.

components.form: One continuous polygonal S-ribbon whose lands remain at least 5 mm wide.
components.interfaces: Boolean-fused to both cloud and bolt with broad finite seating edges.
components.name: S-ribbon rain stem
components.placement: Runs from the central cloud underside at Z59 into the bolt crown at Z33.
components.purpose: Carries the bolt structurally while reading as a swept motion trail.

concept.intended_interaction: Place upright on the keel, nudge either shoulder with one finger to reach an approximately 18-degree crest, watch the framed bolt sweep sideways, and release for passive return toward center.
concept.print_stance: Upright in the functional rest pose with the crescent keel at Z=0; one material, one connected solid, no assembly.
concept.signature_decision: The apparent magic comes from structural contrast: a softly lobed, holdable storm silhouette above a through-arch, one crisp rounded-corner bolt below, and a finite-width S-ribbon that reads as the bolt's own motion trail. The bolt never moves independently; the whole balanced object rocks.
concept.summary: A palm-size, one-piece storm-cloud relief rocker whose open crescent arch frames a lightning jewel; rocking the whole body makes the bolt trace a lateral sweep and gravity returns it to center.
concept.title: Tempest Lull
unresolved_risks: CAD checks cannot prove real printer adhesion, surface finish, rocking duration, or physical durability.
The circular keel has a mathematically unique low point rather than a broad flat; practical rest behavior depends on layer finish and tabletop texture.
The common-depth relief reads as a sculptural storm token rather than a fully rounded cloud plush form.

alternatives_considered: Dual-radius soft cam: stronger pauses but discontinuous feel risk.
Asymmetric spiral keel: dramatic timing but unequal return.
Captive swinging bolt: literal motion but more fragile and less deterministic to print.
research.claim_limits: All measurements and motion statements are geometry-derived. No physical print, human playtest, adhesion, durability, or measured rocking claim is made.
research.hardest_to_fake_magic: The faceted bolt must appear to sweep left and right through a truly open arch while remaining part of one support-free printed solid.
research.method: Wish-specific geometry reasoning and selected-Inventor review; no external factual claims were required.
selected_inventor_findings: Use a constant-radius keel for an analytically checkable restoring path.
Keep the mass center far below the curvature center.
Make the curl a visible motion trail and the load path.
Reject flat clip-art cloud depth and a straight connector.
